$comment: The AfterGlow suite feature map: every feature, the shared layer it is built in, and the apps that adopt it. Belt's GET /belt/blueprints/suite-map joins it to live status. A row's status comes only from its packet: 'packet' is <app>/<feature>, the id of docs/blueprints/<app>/features/<feature>.wave.json, and the row shows that feature's Belt status once the wave.json is on dev; a packet id with no wave.json on dev yet shows 'writing'; a row with no packet is 'new'. Each adopter has the same rule with its own packet (the packet that wires the feature into that app). See docs/factory/packets.md, 'The suite feature map'.
